title: Static Domed Segmented Armor Isopod
description: One newly authored complete stylised marine isopod-like exterior: a broad low compact head under the front edge of a long convex oval segmented armor body, with real transverse material ridges/grooves over the entire curved back, seven pairs of short side walking appendages, paired forward antennae, lateral dark eyes and three rounded posterior tail plates. Body is a complete closed volume with underside, not fossil slab relief extracted and extruded or a lobster with claws removed. All body/head/appendage arrays are new; shared exporter and generic mesh functions only. One static animal prop zero scenes. No exact species/anatomical segment counts, biological age, locomotion, feeding, rig, animation or interaction claim.
